articles.title: Yolanda Haddad, 87, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Yolanda Haddad for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Born in Canal Park in the years after the war, Yolanda Haddad spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Canal Park.
Yolanda Haddad died in April at home on Union Road, at the age of 87. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to Scout Troop 14 in his or her name.
